thread:
Maya: dropped a new set of frames that try to reconcile the threshold controls + channel preview. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/newframes/alert-preview-ux :eyes: Alex: nice exploration. immediate question: slider vs stepper for numeric thresholds? sliders are faster for rough changes but bad for precise SLO numbers. Sam: agree. i'd favor a hybrid: slider for a11y-friendly coarse adjust, plus a numeric input with +/- stepper for exact values. keyboard users can tab to the number input. Tess: copy nit on the preview panel: when routing rules exist, it currently shows the rule name. users expect to see concrete destinations. change copy to "Will notify: #alerts, PagerDuty (svc-ops)". Maya: noted i'll update the annotation. also thinking about the preview kill-switch toggle — if a user disables preview we should persist on a per-user basis. opt-out is valid for high-traffic orgs. Jordan: a11y details: the preview panel must be reachable via keyboard and announce changes. use `aria-live="polite"` for the resolved destinations and `role="status"` when contents update after editing rules. Alex: also microcopy: suppression pill currently reads "Muted" which is ambiguous. prefer "Snoozed until 3:40pm" as it communicates expiry. for very long rules, show truncated text with `aria-label` containing the full rule. Sam: performance: inline preview expansions should not eagerly hydrate for long lists. lazy-load and cache per-alert with a short TTL (5-10min). avoid spamming PD API on hover. Tess: contrast/accessibility: the snooze pill on dark theme fails 3:1 vs body text. bump background to #2b3746 and keep text white. also ensure focus-visible states. small CSS example: ```css .snooze-pill:focus-visible{ outline: 3px solid #ffd966; outline-offset: 2px } .snooze-pill{ background: #2b3746; color: #ffffff } ``` Maya: good. another interaction question: should the preview show the final delivery endpoints only or include a short breadcrumb of which routing rule matched? maybe both: primary view shows endpoints, collapsed metadata shows "via: rule-name" with a disclosure. Jordan: that seems best for engineers troubleshooting misrouting. also add a "what-if" toggle that simulates changing channel mapping without saving; show "Would notify:" results. ensure the toggle has `aria-pressed` state. Alex: timeline/history: people asked for context about when a suppression was applied. small history row under details with entries like "Snoozed by K. Nguyen — 2026-02-10 09:12 UTC" helps on-call decisions. Sam: UX edge: on mobile narrow widths the details rail collapses. ensure runbook/playbook metadata doesn't force horizontal scroll. collapse into stacked rows + an expand CTA. Tess: voiceover announcement: when opening the details rail do: `
Alert details opened for {{shortId}}
` so screen reader users know context. Maya: i'll update figma and add all these a11y annotations + copy changes. can we pair on copy polishing tomorrow 4pm? Alex: works for me. Sam? Sam: yep. Tess: added to calendar. @ops-bot can you create the invite and enable recording? ops-bot: Meeting created: "Design pairing Alert preview + snooze copy" 4:00 PM Wed. Recording enabled.
